nodes.label: LayoutCache
nodes.rationale: Computed once per frame in mod.rs; eliminates per-submodule layout recomputation; mouse hit-testing reads from it between frames; stores menu_labels x-ranges for dynamic popup positioning

nodes.label: WorkspaceState
nodes.rationale: Isolates per-workspace pane/preview/editor/terminal and local transient state; enables instant context switching (Shift+1-4) without mutating other workspaces; each workspace is an independent dual-pane desktop

nodes.label: ratatui-image Crate
nodes.rationale: Replaces hand-rolled halfblock Unicode renderer; auto-detects best terminal graphics protocol (Kitty→Sixels→iTerm2→halfblock); StatefulProtocol handles resize internally, reducing render code from ~80 lines to ~10

nodes.label: Zeta Development Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for all planned and completed waves; maps each wave to a plan file and Jira epic.

nodes.label: Wave 7B: SSH Agent & Host Key Verification
nodes.rationale: Hardens remote filesystem (Wave 7A) with host key verification against known_hosts and SSH agent socket authentication; ssh2 dep already present.
nodes.norm_label: wave 7b: ssh agent & host key verification

nodes.label: Custom Icon Font Design
nodes.rationale: Introduces IconMode::Custom using private-use Unicode codepoints in a bundled TTF; Unicode/ASCII fallbacks preserved; opt-in only since terminal controls font.

nodes.label: Neo-Commander UI/UX Design
nodes.rationale: Defines surface-aware color ladder (brand accent, surface 1-3, muted, state colors) and visual hierarchy for panes, top bar, tools panel, and overlays.

nodes.label: Architecture Remediation & Feature Foundation Design
nodes.rationale: Approved full structural refactor: AppState decomposed into PaneSetState/OverlayState/PreviewState/EditorState, multi-worker jobs, modal exclusivity via OverlayState enum.

nodes.label: File Operation Identity Hardening Design
nodes.rationale: Adds FileOperationIdentity to results so batch settlement uses canonical identity rather than queue order or current_path semantics.

nodes.label: Operation Safety Hardening Design
nodes.rationale: Hardens copy/move/delete/trash/rename/batch workflows: deterministic batch ordering, prompt truthfulness, marks preserved until outcome known, refresh targets per affected path.

nodes.label: Workspaces Design
nodes.rationale: Adds 4 independent dual-pane working contexts; each WorkspaceState owns PaneSetState/PreviewState/EditorState/TerminalState; async jobs carry workspace_id for isolated routing.

nodes.label: Flyout Submenu Design
nodes.rationale: Moves Themes tab from top-level menu into a flyout under View; extends ModalState::Menu with optional flyout field; auto-opens on hover of trigger item.

nodes.label: Git Diff Viewer Design
nodes.rationale: Ctrl+D toggles git_diff_active mode replacing dual panes with changed-files list + unified diff; adds GitDiffFile/DiffLine types to src/git.rs; fields added to WorkspaceState.

nodes.label: UI/UX Revamp Design
nodes.rationale: Full visual overhaul: Catppuccin Mocha palette, NerdFont v3 icon codepoints (renames IconMode::Custom to NerdFont), Halo+Dim modal depth, status bar 4-zone layout, workspace selector in menu bar.

nodes.label: Preview Enhancements Design
nodes.rationale: Replaces hand-rolled halfblock renderer with ratatui-image (Kitty→Sixels→iTerm2→halfblock); adds Archive and HexDump ViewBuffer variants; no new binary deps for archive/hex.

nodes.label: Site Redesign Design
nodes.rationale: Refreshes site/index.html with dual-accent palette (periwinkle #82aaff + sage green #c3e88d), terminal-chrome hero frame, What's New cards, remains single-file dependency-free.

nodes.label: Update Checks & Self-Update Design
nodes.rationale: Non-blocking startup check via GitHub API; pulsing status bar indicator; ureq HTTP dep (sync, no async runtime); binary replacement via cargo install; UpdateState at global AppState level.

nodes.label: Zeta GitHub Pages Site
nodes.rationale: Single-file static GitHub Pages site; dual-accent CSS variables (--accent: #82aaff periwinkle, --accent2: #c3e88d sage green); monospace font stack; terminal chrome hero with app.png.

nodes.label: WorkspaceState
nodes.rationale: Per-workspace state container owning PaneSetState, PreviewState, EditorState, TerminalState, and local transient state; isolated from other workspaces; async job results routed by workspace_id.

nodes.label: FileOperationIdentity
nodes.rationale: Small type (kind, source, destination) derived from submitted FileOperation; carried by completion/collision/failure results so batch settlement uses canonical identity rather than queue order.

nodes.label: IconMode
nodes.rationale: Enum controlling icon rendering: Ascii → Unicode → Custom/NerdFont; single source of truth for icon selection; fallback chain preserved; user sets via config.toml icon_mode key.

nodes.label: ViewBuffer
nodes.rationale: Enum of preview content variants: Text, Highlighted, Image, Markdown, Archive (new), HexDump (new); determines which render path the preview panel takes.

nodes.label: AppState Decomposition
nodes.rationale: AppState becomes thin coordinator delegating to PaneSetState, OverlayState, PreviewState, EditorState; apply() fans out to sub-reducers; eliminates god-object and modal exclusivity bugs.

nodes.label: ModalState Enum

nodes.label: FocusLayer Enum
nodes.rationale: Replaces RouteContext with 9 booleans; modal priority encoded once in focus_layer() method; app.rs and state/mod.rs both consume it with no duplication
